stem.text: In an experiment on $\alpha$-particle scattering, $\alpha$-particles are directed at a thin gold foil. Most of the $\alpha$-particles pass straight through the foil or are deflected by a small angle. A small number of $\alpha$-particles are deflected by a large angle.
Which statement **cannot** be deduced from this experiment?

B.text: Most of the mass of an atom is concentrated in the nucleus.

C.text: The nucleus of an atom contains protons.

D.text: The nucleus of an atom is small compared to the size of an atom.
